Name: Busty Farmer Edited PoppingOut Sleeves Nude
Author: Untolddead
Description:
This mod has popping out popping out with sleeves and a nudity mod with the curvy model. Please enjoy!

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/146717268]stellaimprtrx[/url] for the config file. I didn't use any of his config but with out him sending it to me I wouldn't have bothered making the config!

Not compatible with any mods that changes replaces the [u][b]arm sprites[/b][/u]. This is true for all version of busty farmer.

3/22/2024 Configs currently don't update in game in order to change the sprite you must set it and restart your game.

According to Avvvocado KNOWN INCOMPATIBILITY ISSUES:
-Get Glam: get glam causes the boobs to disappear when your farmer wears a bikini in the spa, a patched version is currently in the works
Lewddew valley overwrites pants for no reason. No one has complained yet and lewdew hasn't been updated in a long time and is glitchy. It's just the base file from the game. This messes up the underwear and swimsuit. Fix- over write Sloppy zap undies manifest with:
{
  "Name": "Sloppy Zap Undies",

  "Description": "A quick and sloppy removal of underwear",

The dependencies is the addition. it just forces zap undies to run after lewdew so it over writes the underwear.
